body:
# Retro Camera Mod (1998 Style)

A gameplay and visual overhaul for Minecraft Beta 1.3_01 that transforms the game into a top-down, retro-style experience inspired by early 3D games.

## Features

- Top-down camera perspective
- Custom player and item rendering
- Different poses for blocks and tools
- Some animations in this mod are inspired by 98Demake.
- Simplified health UI (single heart with counter)
- Improved visibility with block outline and camera adjustments
- Adjusted FOV for a more retro look

## Compatibility

This mod only works with **Minecraft Beta 1.3_01**.  
Other Beta 1.3 versions or development builds are not supported.

## Installation

This is a jar mod (base edit).

To install:
- Open MultiMC or Betacraft
- Add the mod to `minecraft.jar`

## Notes

This is version 0.1.0, focused on core gameplay and functionality.  
Some visual issues or rough edges may still exist.
